From today, Runna subscribers can use the new "Adapt for Heat" feature, which automatically adjusts pace targets based on local temperature and humidity. Details below.

Runna launches training tool that adapts to heat

The personal running coach app Runna announced three updates today, designed to support users throughout their training cycle, from training in hot weather to post-race recovery.

The new "Adapt for Heat" feature, launching today, will help users find cooler running times and suggest adjusted pace targets based on feels-like temperature, workout duration, and specific session types.

Adapt for Heat provides a color-coded hourly weather forecast, allowing users to quickly identify the best times to run and schedule their training accordingly.

Here's Runna's introduction to this new feature:

Runna also announced the relaunch of its "Post-Race Recovery Plan" feature, which will automatically generate a recovery programme once a user begins a race plan ranging from 5K to 50K. Runna head coach and former Olympian Steph Kessell said these plans are designed by professional coaches to help runners "reduce the risk of burnout or injury."

Finally, the platform announced a new feature called "Upcoming Plans" set to launch in August. Users can queue up multiple training plans in advance, with the next plan automatically kicking in after the previous one is completed, making long-term training flow more seamlessly.

Here's Runna's introduction to the Upcoming Plans feature:

Plan your entire year of training in minutes: runners can stack races, milestone goals, and training blocks, seeing their full year of training at a glance. No admin between plans: no need to rebuild or start over—your familiar training schedule, predicted race times, and current fitness level carry straight into the next plan once your current one ends. Flexibility and full control: every plan can be edited, swapped, or deleted at any time, giving runners complete ownership of their training experience. Built for progress: every plan is built by Runna's expert coaches following established training principles, helping runners progress steadily, recover properly, and show up on race day ready.
